aiSummary: In October 2026, Safari iPad led browser versions (tablet) in Australia at 38.9% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Chrome iPad ranked second at 28.05%, followed by Chrome for Android at 24.27%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (tablet) in Australia?
faqs.answer: Safari iPad leads at 38.9% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-version-market-share/tablet/australia.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (tablet) in Australia?
faqs.answer: Safari iPad (38.9%), Chrome iPad (28.05%), Chrome for Android (24.27%) in October 2026.
